outcome_definition: Outcome = dTm (C) of a triple-homozygous control relative to CCC/CCC, read from the derivative melting curve. All three SNPs are C>T (class I transitions) in one GC-rich promoter: this is a per-locus effect for THIS amplicon and must not be generalised to transversions or to other sequence context.
